zh-Hans: 比赛不只是干干净净地比速度。运用心理战，打乱对手节奏，这才是东堂塾的较量！
en: A battle isn't just a clean contest of speed. Using tactics to break your opponent's rhythm is how Todo School fights!

zh-Hans: 得找个地方超过去！
en: I'll have to find a place to pass him!

zh-Hans: 原来如此，他的本事我大致摸清了。
en: I see. I've got a pretty good measure of his ability.

zh-Hans: 再观察一会儿吧。
en: I'll watch him a little longer.

zh-Hans: 你也就现在还能得意！
en: Enjoy it while it lasts!

zh-Hans: 比想象中快，过弯也漂亮。
en: He's faster than I expected. Good in the corners too.

zh-Hans: 不该这样！可恶，我的 INTE R 怎么会输！
en: This can't be right! Damn it, my INTE R isn't losing!

zh-Hans: 看这架势，说不定比我预想的强。
en: Judging by that, he might be better than I thought.

zh-Hans: 是快，速度倒是有。
en: He's fast. I'll give him that.

zh-Hans: 这反应速度，简直不像人类。
en: Those reflexes are barely human.

zh-Hans: 怎么会这样，完全没想到！
en: How did this happen? I never saw it coming!

zh-Hans: 旁边一旦并上一辆车，路线被卡住，过弯速度就会大跌！
en: A car alongside restricts your line and kills your corner speed!

zh-Hans: 什么？！
en: What?!

zh-Hans: 切！
en: Tch!

zh-Hans: 什么？！
en: What?!

zh-Hans: 可恶！
en: Gah!

zh-Hans: 怎么可能？！
en: Impossible!

zh-Hans: 糟了！
en: I blew it!

zh-Hans: 怎么了？到底发生了什么？！
en: What? What's happening?!

zh-Hans: 没想到他竟然强到这种程度。
en: I never thought he'd be this good.

zh-Hans: 怎么会，不该是这样……
en: No... This can't be right...

zh-Hans: 跟上来吧，我布下的陷阱已经开始起作用了！
en: Follow me. My trap is already in motion!

zh-Hans: 好车手，能准确抓住我的路线和时机跟上来。但这恰恰会要了你的命！
en: He's a good driver, reading my line and timing so well. But that's exactly what will be his undoing!

zh-Hans: 让你见识东堂塾有多难缠！
en: I'll show you just how nasty Todo School can be!

zh-Hans: 你咬得越紧，我的战术就越管用！
en: The closer you follow, the better my tactics work!

zh-Hans: 怎么回事，他追上来了！
en: What the hell? He's catching up!

zh-Hans: 赌上东堂塾的面子也不能输！无论如何，我都要这样冲线！
en: I can't lose with Todo School's pride at stake! Whatever it takes, I'm staying ahead to the finish!

zh-Hans: 人人都说给 VTEC 加涡轮是邪道呢。
en: Everyone says putting a turbo on a VTEC is sacrilege.

zh-Hans: INTE R 加涡轮果然选对了，跟设想的完全一样！
en: The INTE R and turbo combination was the right call. Exactly as I pictured it!

zh-Hans: 这不过是打个招呼罢了！
en: That's just a little greeting!

zh-Hans: 为了赢，能用的技术可多着呢。你最好记住这点！
en: There are all kinds of techniques for winning. You'd better remember that!

zh-Hans: 你还太嫩。
en: You're still green.

zh-Hans: 别怪我，现在的我，就是必须赢才行！
en: No hard feelings. I'm in a position where I have to win!

zh-Hans: 赢是理所当然的。东堂塾要是被小看，可就完了！
en: I'm supposed to win. We can't let anyone look down on Todo School!

zh-Hans: 害我捏了把汗，不过也到此为止了！
en: You gave me a scare, but this ends now!

zh-Hans: 哼。
en: Hmph.

zh-Hans: 嗯。
en: Hmm.

zh-Hans: 呵呵呵……
en: Heh-heh-heh...

zh-Hans: 哼。
en: Hm.

zh-Hans: 哈哈哈！
en: Ha-ha-ha!

zh-Hans: 这场比赛，我大概什么收获也不会有。
en: I doubt I'll gain anything from this battle.

zh-Hans: 我们在东堂塾受过磨炼，再看这种水平，实在让人失望！
en: After the training we've had at Todo School, this level is a real disappointment!

zh-Hans: 就这点本事？真让人失望。
en: Is that all? What a letdown.

zh-Hans: 要是跑得太烂、让人失望，那就超过去，直接结束！
en: If his driving's a disappointment, I'll just pass him and finish it!

zh-Hans: 拜托了，B18C 涡轮！
en: I'm counting on you, B18C turbo!
